t: Building an AI-Infused Web Framework with HTMX, Nix Flakes, and AI
s: The author describes the iterative process of building a future-proof web framework by converging HTMX for HTML-centric development, Nix Flakes for robust infrastructure, and AI for automation and intelligent contracts. The focus is on strategic priorities, customer success, and leveraging link-graph visualization for SEO audits.
